name: Desertion
game_text:
To play, spot an <culture>Isengard</culture> Man. Plays on a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
<phase>Assignment</phase>: Assign an <culture>Isengard</culture> minion with less strength than bearer to skirmish bearer. Discard this condition.
flavor_text: “‘Who knows what you’ve spoken to the darkness in the bitter watches of the night?’”
